headline: Gold eases slightly today; silver down about 5% over the past week
summary: Today's move is tiny: 24-carat gold is ₹13,603 per gram, down just ₹1 (0.01%) from yesterday, and 22-carat is down ₹1 as well. Over the last 7 days gold has fallen about 4.2% and silver about 5%, and over the 24 days in our history silver has dropped roughly 13.7% from ₹2,20,000 to ₹1,89,900 per kg, while gold is down about 4.7%. Likely drivers include a firmer US dollar against the rupee and softer international prices, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins, prices are near the lowest level in our recent history, so compare making charges and GST across shops rather than rushing, since the trend can change quickly.
